description: Source code for H265 NALU parser, including functions for locating and parsing NAL units, handling encrypted ranges, and managing stream state.

classes.name: H265NALU
classes.description: Represents an H265 NAL unit, containing data pointer and size.

classes.name: H265NaluParser
classes.description: Parser for H265 NAL units, capable of locating, parsing, and managing encrypted stream data.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets parser state, clearing stream pointers and encrypted ranges.

methods.name: SetStream
methods.description: Sets the stream data for parsing.

methods.name: SetEncryptedStream
methods.description: Sets the stream data along with encryption information.

methods.name: LocateNALU
methods.description: Finds the next NAL unit in the stream.

methods.name: AdvanceToNextNALU
methods.description: Advances parser to the next NAL unit, parsing header information.

methods.name: GetCurrentSubsamples
methods.description: Returns the current subsample entries overlapping the last parsed NALU.
